findings.detail: This leaf benchmarks FIDDLE formula-prediction accuracy across pre-existing ClassyFire strata and does not perform CANOPUS or NPClassifier class prediction.
This leaf compares frequencies in existing CANOPUS and MolNetEnhancer annotations and does not predict compound classes from the stage input.
This leaf parses SIRIUS and ZODIAC outputs to benchmark formula accuracy and error rates rather than filtering annotations by confidence.
This leaf selects ZODIAC posterior thresholds for formula annotations but omits COSMIC structure-confidence filtering from the requested stage.
This leaf reranks existing SIRIUS formula candidates with ZODIAC but does not perform the initial isotope-pattern and fragmentation-tree formula determination.
This leaf reranks candidate structures against a CSI:FingerID-predicted fingerprint but omits COSMIC confidence scoring from the requested structure-prediction stage.
